capabilities.body: OpenAmer bɛ baara labɛn, a kɛ ni baarakɛminɛn lakikaw ye — cikanw sɛbɛnyɔrɔ, ɛntɛrinɛti ɲininiyɔrɔ, dosiyew, porogaramu sɛbɛn — ani ka fɛn min bɛ baara kɛ mara.
capabilities.title: Dɛmɛbaga min bɛ miiri i fɛ

capabilities.body: Barow, hakilijagabɔ ani miiri misaliw bɛ mara nin masin kan. Foyi tɛ ci ɛntɛrinɛti kan ni i ma a ɲini.
capabilities.title: I ka masin, i ka kunnafonidaw

capabilities.body: Kan 186, kelen kelen bɛɛ ni i bɛ sɛbɛnni suguya min kalan. Porogaramu ɲɛfɔlɔ bɛ i ɲininka i ka kan na.
capabilities.title: I ka kan, a ɲɛnama

capabilities.body: Kɔrɔlenyaw bɛ mara ka bɔ baara yɛrɛ la, o la don o don baara bɛ nɔgɔya i bɛ a kɛcogo la.
capabilities.title: Se min bɛ bonya

help: A lajɛ ni nin masin bɛ se ka don ɛntɛrinɛti kan.
Labɛnni daminɛ tuguni — taabolo dafalenw tɛ kɛ tuguni.
Ni a ma ɲɛ siɲɛ fila, kɛwalew sɛbɛnw dayɛlɛ; sɛbɛn kun labanw bɛ taabolo tɔgɔ jira.
failure.lead: Yɛlɛma si ma bɔ yen dogo la — OpenAmer bɛ to a jɔyɔrɔ la, o la daminɛni filanan bɛ taa ɲɛ o yɔrɔ la.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer bɛ a suguya kɔrɔ la hali bi, a bɛ baara kɛ. Foyi ma falen ka to tilancɛ la.
failure.title: Labɛnni ma dafa

language.lead: Labɛnni bɛ taa ɲɛ ni i ye kan min sugandi yan. I bɛ se ka a yɛlɛma kɔfɛ porogaramu kɔnɔ.
language.title: I ka kan sugandi

progress.lead: Labɛnni siɲɛ kelen: OpenAmer bɛ a mago fɛnw telesarse ka nin masin labɛn. Daminɛni nataw tɛ o kɛ tuguni.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer bɛ suguya kɔrɔ falen. I ka baarada ɲɛnabɔw, hakilijagabɔ ani labɛnniw tɛ maga.
progress.liveOutput: Kunnafoni bɔlenw o waati yɛrɛ la
progress.title: OpenAmer labɛnni

stages.configure: API kilɛw ani miiri misaliw labɛnni

cards.body: Porogaramu dayɛlɛ ka baara min ka kan ka kɛ ɲɛfɔ. OpenAmer bɛ baara kɛ kɔfɛ ka a jaabi lase i ma.
cards.title: A daminɛ ni kumasen ye

cards.body: Labɛnniw → Jirali → Kan. Kan ni jamana labɛnni 186, i bɛ se ka u yɛlɛma waati bɛɛ.
cards.title: I ka kan sugandi

cards.body: Baara seginseginnen bɛ kɛ kɔrɔlenya ye — a nata la, cikan kelen bɛ bɔ a la.
cards.title: A to a ka hakili to a la

success.command: walima a daminɛ kɔfɛ cikanw sɛbɛnyɔrɔ la:
success.errorTitle: Ordinatɛri porogaramu ma se ka daminɛ
success.lead: Fɛn bɛɛ labɛnnen don. Sisan OpenAmer ye i ta ye — nin masin kan, i ka kan na.
success.title: OpenAmer labɛnnen don

bullets: A bɛ baara kɛ nin masin kan — i ka barow bɛ to nin masin kan
Kan 186, i bɛ sɛbɛnni suguya min kalan fana bɛ a la
I bɛ se ka fɛn bɛɛ yɛlɛma kɔfɛ; foyi tɛ to cogo kelen na abada
welcome.lead: I yɛrɛ ka dɛmɛbaga. I ka masin kan. I ka kan na.
welcome.leadUpdate: OpenAmer suguya kuraman labɛnnen don. Nin bɛ suguya kɔrɔ falen ka baarada ɲɛnabɔw ni labɛnniw bɛɛ mara.
welcome.note: A bɛ miniti damadɔ ta ɛntɛrinɛti jɛɲɔgɔnya ɲuman kan.
welcome.title: I ni sɛ OpenAmer la
